flags: WATERFRONT LEAD lakeview -> lakefront (upgrade, review): measured to the recorded high-water line, not the drawn-down lake in the imagery. CDEC shows Pine Flat reaching 948-951 ft in 2011, 2017, 2023 and 2024; on 3DEP (crest check +0.7 m) that is ~290.3 m. Reservable nightly sites 43 (36.864668,-119.314839) 290.7 m, 47/48 (36.865071,-119.315347) 291.1 m, 49 (36.865025,-119.315579) 291.8 m, 34 (36.864053,-119.314294) 290.9 m and 33 (36.864025,-119.313602) 290.0 m sit 0-1.5 m above that line over open grass, the ground dropping to 286.6 m 15 m out from 47/48 - kayak test passes at high water.
